title: I painted my mall area that leads to 'haunted house' attraction
content: As an artist, i thought it would help me to paint and visualize some areas that i visit often since everyone in my life thinks these dreams are weird. There's an area by a food court (by the maze of bathrooms everyone else seems to experience) that resembles a movie theater that I go to a lot. But in the big black shadow Is a long hallway that goes back to a 'haunted house' of sorts where people are jumping out at me to scare me but they don't actually touch me. I know it's fake but it's still terrifying, like a real haunted attraction. I go so often that I already know where each scare is, and now I try my best to avoid it. Other areas in this mall are the elevator, bathroom, waterpark, airport, tunnels, and conference center. Does anyone else have this in their dream??
